sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Grand Haven State Park resources via /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/attribute/filterable)

values.note: DNR rate table: Grand Haven Campground $45 a night with 20/30-amp, $50 with 50-amp (modern campground). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Grand Haven / Grand Haven Campground: Modern camping 50 AMP rate $50, 20/30 AMP rate $45) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/grandhaven ('Recreation Passport required. A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/grandhaven ('Electrical service', 'Some campsites with 50-amp service') + midnrreservations.com resources (all 172 campsites 'Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup: No'; 20/30 amps at all, 50 amps at 112), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The park page says 174 sites; the booking site lists 172 campsites plus 5 overflow sites, 5 of them ADA-only. All paved (asphalt), level, full sun and back-in, two vehicles per site; 40 are marked waterfront. Sites sit closer together than at other state parks.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/grandhaven ('Number of sites: 174', 'The sites are a little closer in proximity', 'The sites are paved') + midnrreservations.com resources (Campsite 172, Overflow 5; Pull Through: No on all; Ground Cover Asphalt; Adjacent To Waterfront 40; ADA Only 5), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No fire pits: campers may bring an enclosed portable firepit at least 6 inches above the sand; no ground fires. Sanitation station in the campground (two lanes, potable water).

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/grandhaven ('Toilet & shower building', 'The park's sanitation station is in the campground. There is potable water available and two lanes', 'Concession or store', firepit rules), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/grandhaven ('Grand Haven Modern Campground: For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed the DNR's $45 (20/30-amp) / $50 (50-amp) rates and the Recreation Passport requirement (fees now manual, Passport in fees.note), reservable on midnrreservations.com; season May 1 - Oct 21 already manual. Added 50-amp electric with no water/sewer at sites, 172 paved back-in campsites (park page says 174), showers/flush toilets/sanitation station/store. --AWH note matches the park page ('sites are a little closer in proximity'); left unchanged. Not stated for this park: booking window, max stay, fcfs, max rig length.
